label: Each participant has a distinct actual own-being cause of esse
paraphrase: Analyst formulation, attribution deferred. Each x with the existing q44 Participated predicate has some c distinct from x, in act as to esse, that is its own subsistent being (the existing primitive OwnBeing) and causes x in the esse respect. This adds essential possession at the causal source to the local external-cause conclusion. It does not assert the premise, identify all such sources or make causation efficient, conserving or modal.
